person: Consiglia De Martino (Lina), wife of Antonio Rinaldi
tier: 1: specific miracle officially accepted for beatification
condition: Large left supraclavicular, mediastinal and abdominal/retroperitoneal fluid collection, attributed to thoracic duct rupture; estimated roughly 2 litres. Original reproduced discharge/attestation qualify mechanism as suspected/presumptive traumatic filtration/rupture.
hospital: Ospedali Riuniti S. Giovanni di Dio e Ruggi d’Aragona, Salerno; III General Surgery division
treatment: Vatican decree and physician account explicitly report no therapy before resolution; surgery considered but not performed. Diagnostic CT/ultrasound/Xray were performed.
timeline: Symptoms 31 Oct; admission and two CT examinations 1 Nov; reduction 2 Nov; swelling absent 3 Nov in decree/clinical reconstruction; ultrasound 4 Nov and repeat CT 6 Nov reported clear. Later devotional anniversary account shifts key healing to 4 Nov; preserve clinical dates.
medical_review: 30 April 1998 medical board;22 June theologians;20 October cardinals/bishops;21 December 1998 decree. Beatification 2 May 1999.
